reflection: The notebook shows that most factors help in 2023 and 2025 but flip in 2024 (trending, low-vol year) and sometimes 2022. aapl_msft_gap_trend_agree is the best promising factor (big 2025 gains), but heavy-tailed raw products probably cause the 2022/2024 flips. Scaling by Apple vol did not fix it. I will try rank-like/bounded versions (sign times magnitude, zscore) and new ideas around MSFT-specific relationships, volume-price divergences, and QQQ-based market state. I will also pair the MSFT gap factor with bounded market-state partners.

lessons.name: aapl_msft_gap_trend_agree_vol_scaled
lessons.lesson: Dividing the 20d gap by Apple vol kept the 2023/2025 gains but still failed in 2022 and 2024, so heavy tails were not the main problem and the regime dependence remains.

lessons.name: aapl_msft_gap_10d_60d_hybrid
lessons.lesson: The 5d x 10d gap product overlaps too much in horizon, helping LR in 2022/2023 but flipping in 2024/2025, so horizon separation matters.

lessons.name: aapl_qqq_trend_gap_agree
lessons.lesson: The same agreement idea against QQQ only helped LR and in 2023, showing the MSFT-specific gap carries the information, not generic market-relative gaps.

lessons.name: nvda_return_volume_surprise
lessons.lesson: Multiplying NVDA return by a volume ratio left it a 0.99 copy of the return because the return's scale dominates the product.

lessons.name: qqq_trend_strength_for_gap
lessons.lesson: A QQQ 10d trend-to-vol ratio is just a rescaled market momentum that hurt in three years and carried no unique signal despite pairing slightly with the MSFT gap.

lessons.name: aapl_msft_corr_break_gap
lessons.lesson: A 1d Apple-MSFT gap scaled by MSFT vol ratio is a near-copy of the existing 1d relative factor and added only noise.

factors.name: aapl_msft_gap_sign_agree_mag
factors.hypothesis: The raw product of two gaps is heavy-tailed and flips in 2022/2024; keeping only the sign of the 20d gap gives a bounded trend-conditioned short gap (continuation vs reversal) that should be more stable.

factors.name: aapl_msft_gap_trend_agree_zscore
factors.hypothesis: The 20d Apple-MSFT gap relative to its own 60d distribution removes regime-scale differences between 2022 and 2024, giving a stationary relative strength state.

factors.name: aapl_volume_price_divergence_5d
factors.hypothesis: Price rising while volume is relatively low (or the opposite) signals weak conviction and mean reversion; a normalized divergence is regime-neutral.

factors.name: qqq_down_day_share_10d_vs_aapl
factors.hypothesis: The 10d mean-return lag of Apple vs QQQ captures whether Apple is catching up to the sector, a slower-moving relative state than the 1d and 5d factors.

factors.name: qqq_range_ratio_for_msft_gap
factors.hypothesis: The MSFT gap factor works in high-vol 2025 and not calm 2024; a QQQ range expansion state lets the model switch the gap's meaning by market turbulence.

factors.name: msft_nvda_volume_pulse_for_gap
factors.hypothesis: When MSFT trades unusually heavily relative to Apple, MSFT's move carries more information, making the Apple-MSFT gap more or less likely to persist; this complements the price gap.
